put.description: Retire or reactivate a bike with expectedVersion. A retired bike keeps its history but takes no new rides or parts.

get.description: The parts fitted now, the rides that will be kept and the maintenance records that will be deleted with the bike.

post.description: Permanently delete a bike in one transaction: kept parts become spares, other fitted parts, maintenance, the reminder rule and exemptions are deleted, and rides stay under the bike's name.

put.description: Edit make, model and weight with expectedVersion. Type, installations and usage never change.

delete.description: Permanently delete a spare or fitted part with expectedVersion. Its fittings go, leaving gaps; its maintenance records stay unlinked.

get.description: Fixed positions, component types, groups and labels. Clients render from this and never copy it.

post.description: Declare a position intentionally empty from startUtc (front derailleur none fitted, or a tubeless wheel). Any open part there is ended at startUtc and needs expectedInstallationVersion.

get.description: The bike's intentionally empty periods, newest first.

put.description: Correct or end an exemption with expectedVersion. Ending it means the position needs a part again.

post.description: Install a compatible component using [startUtc,endUtc) UTC intervals. Whole rides allocate by start instant.

put.description: Correct dates with expectedVersion. Overlaps and stale versions return 409; totals rebuild atomically.

post.description: Move a fitted part to another bike or position in one step. An occupied destination needs expectedDestinationInstallationVersion; its part returns to the garage.
Create two parts of one front/rear type and fit them to both ends from startUtc, all or nothing.
Record work without resetting component lifetime usage; cost/currency are optional together.

put.description: Correct a ride with expectedVersion; its history and rebuilt usage commit together.

get.description: Lifetime and per-installation usage. Seconds include only known durations; hasUnknownDuration flags incomplete hours. Estimates are separate from calculated usage.
Current components as of now, explained totals and missing installation history by position. Allocation gaps are not guessed.
